meta.title: Teuta Apartment — beachfront apartment in Durrës, Albania
meta.description: A one-bedroom apartment on the first line of the beach in Durrës. Sea-view balcony, free parking, sleeps five. Message on WhatsApp for dates.
meta.ogAlt: The Adriatic seen from the balcony of Teuta Apartment in Durrës

apartment.title: One bedroom, one balcony, and the whole Adriatic in front of it.
apartment.body: The sea is the first thing you see as the curtains open in the morning. Beyond the balcony, you see the umbrellas, the palm trees, and then the water, and that is the entire distance separating your bed from the beach.

host.title: Meet the host
host.intro: I have been hosting this apartment since 2021, maintaining a 9.8 average rating on Booking.com. My academic background is in cybersecurity engineering, while hosting is something I continue to do simply because I genuinely enjoy welcoming guests and creating a great experience for them.

gettingHere.title: Twenty minutes from the airport, and you're on the sand.

steps.title: Fly into Tirana
steps.body: The drive to the apartment takes 20 to 30 minutes depending on traffic.

steps.title: Shuttle on request — €{price}
steps.body: Send your flight number when you book and someone will be waiting at arrivals.

steps.title: Driving yourself
steps.body: Parking is free and next to the building, so the car can stay put all week.

payment.question: How do I pay?
payment.body: No deposit. You pay in cash when you arrive, in euros or lek. Nothing else on top.

rows.question: What time is check-in and check-out?
rows.body: From 14:00, out by 11:00. If your flight lands early or late, message me and we'll work it out.

rows.question: How do I get the keys?
rows.body: I meet you at the apartment and hand them over in person. Send a message when you're on your way.

rows.question: Is there a minimum stay?
rows.body: Four nights in high season, three nights the rest of the year.

guides.metaTitle: What to do in Durrës — Teuta Apartment
guides.metaDescription: Notes on Durrës from someone who lives on the beach here: the Roman amphitheatre under the town, how the beach day actually runs, what to order, and four days out.
guides.title: What to do in Durrës
guides.intro: Things worth doing within an hour distance, written down the way I would tell you at the table. A quick note before you dive in: I’ve left out opening times and prices. Those change all the time, and I’d much rather you just ask me so I can give you the right answer.

home.title: What to do in Durrës
home.body: Notes on the town from the balcony — where to go, when the beach is worth it, and what to order once you get there.

contact.title: Ask me about your dates
contact.body: I answer on WhatsApp, usually within the hour. Tell me when you're coming and how many of you there are.
contact.prefill: Hello! I saw the Teuta Apartment website and I'd like to ask about your available dates.
